description: Source file implementing a ScreenCapture plugin for a media or device management framework. Contains code for capturing, processing, and uploading screenshots from various hardware-specific sources, including Nexus, DRM, Broadcom, and Intel. Manages registration, initialization, and event notification for screen capture operations.

classes.name: ScreenCapture
classes.description: Main plugin class responsible for handling screen capture operations, including initialization, screenshot acquisition from various sources, and uploading images.

classes.name: ScreenCaptureStore
classes.description: Class handling storage or callback for screen capture data.

classes.name: ScreenShotJob
classes.description: Job class managing scheduled screenshot tasks.

methods.name: uploadScreenCapture
methods.description: Handles the JSON-RPC method to trigger screen capture upload, initiates capture based on hardware source.

methods.name: getScreenShot
methods.description: Captures a screenshot from available hardware sources and uploads it.

methods.name: doUploadScreenCapture
methods.description: Uploads PNG data to the specified URL and notifies about success or failure.

methods.name: uploadDataToUrl
methods.description: Uploads binary image data to a specified URL using libcurl.

methods.name: saveToPng
methods.description: Converts raw image data into PNG format stored in a byte vector.
